sentence_en: A reassessment by infectology was performed, which indicated vancomycin 1 g intravenously, a drug that caused significant clinical improvement in the patient.

In the evolution after surgical drainage and replacement of antibiotic therapy, the patient presented a decrease in the increase in volume and a stabilization of the respiratory rate.
The last hematology recorded revealed a white series of 8,600 U/mm3, at the expense of neutrophils (78%), hemoglobin of 9.5 g/dl, hematocrit of 32.7% and creatinine of 6.8 mg/dl.

Examination of the smears shows, on a seroproteinaceous background, abundant large-sized cellularity, with central and occasionally peripheral, rounded nuclei, with an inconspicuous nucleolus and finely granular chromatin.
The cytoplasm is very characteristic, being abundant, pale and foamy with imprecise edges, vacuolized and containing abundant violet granules.
The cells are arranged in more or less compact groups of large two-dimensional sheets, sometimes adopting an acinar architectural pattern.
Along with this predominant cellularity, smaller cells are also seen, with little cytoplasm and a small central rounded or oval nucleus.

With the cytological diagnosis of acinar cell carcinoma and the cytometric prognostic index of low grade, conservative surgical intervention was performed, with excision of the parotid gland without cervical dissection and preserving the facial nerve.
Macroscopically we find a whitish piece, with a polylobed morphology, weighing 12 grams and total measurements of 8 x 4 x 3 cm.
The section reveals a 1.5 cm nodular lesion that does not overflow the surgical resection ends, apparently not cystic.
Multiple parallel sections of the sample are made, which are embedded in paraffin and the sections are then stained with conventional hematoxylin-eosin.
The histopathological study shows a solid, microcystic neoformation, well circumscribed, composed mainly of acinar cells that do not overflow the glandular capsule.
The multiple very small cystic spaces, scattered between the solid sheets, are formed by dilated lumens lined by intercalated ductal cells, although acinar cells also occasionally participate.
The acinar cells have serous secretion, as demonstrated by PAS (periodic acid Schiff) staining, which highlights intracytoplasmic zymogen granules as well as intracystic eosinophilic secretion.

sentence_en: The neoplasia respects the resection ends and no vascular or nerve infiltration is evident.

sentence_en: The surgical piece obtained through curettage included several irregular fragments of grayish color and low consistency that together measured 0.8 x 0.7 cm and a canine (0.9 x 0.5 cm) product of the extraction.

The histological study showed an unaltered tooth structure, accompanied by fragments of fibrous tissue within which numerous solid nests of odontogenic epithelial elements arranged in compact micronodular formations with a swirling cellular arrangement could be seen.
The elements that made up these structures were of basaloid morphology, with monomorphic, oval or fusiform nuclei, somewhat hyperchromatic, although without evidence of divisional activity.
Mixed with these structures, glandular formations appeared, sometimes tubular in appearance, with a lining of cylindrical, homogeneous cells and nuclei often polarized towards their base.

At the intercellular level and in a dispersed manner, small calcified basophilic spherules appeared as well as areas of irregular contour of amorphous and hyaline deposit, of PAS + diastase resistant character, positive to Congo Red although without green refraction being observed against polarized light.
Given these data, the diagnosis of adenomatoid odontogenic tumor of the follicular type associated with retention of canine dental structure was issued.
sentence_es: Ante estos datos se emitió el diagnostico de tumor odontogénico adenomatoide de tipo folicular asociado a retención de estructura dental canina.

sentence_en: Using the resected soft tissue material, an immunohistochemical study was carried out that first showed a reactivity of the proliferating elements, both in the nodular and adenomatoid areas, against the AE1-3 keratin cocktail.

Likewise, nuclear positivity was observed for the p63 protein (marker of basal or progenitor cells), with this nuclear reactivity being present both in the glandular areas and in the swirling nests of spindle cells.
The proliferation marker Ki-67 marked only 2-3% of the cells that constitute the tumor lesion, with positivity often appearing grouped with some nodules of spindle cells.
The detection of the melanin differentiation markers HMB45 and Melan-A was negative, as was that of the estrogen (ER) and progesterone hormone receptors (RPg) and beta-2-microglobulin.

sentence_en: He had been working for 12 years as a welder in a company manufacturing steel discs that had inserted cobalt and tungsten carbide "teeth" used to cut marble and granite.
The welder used an autogenous welding system that used, as filler metal, metal rods based on: silver (39%), cadmium (25%), copper (22%) and zinc (14%).
He consumed 1 Kg/week; He did not use respiratory protective equipment and his workplace did not have a localized smoke extraction system.
The cadmium concentrations at his workplace were 52 μg/m3 (Environmental Limit Value (ELV) is 10 μg/m3).

During the twelve years that he was working, he had undergone an initial examination and two non-specific periodic examinations without controlling exposure to cadmium and other chemical contaminants; Laboratory results were within normal limits (complete blood count, blood glucose, cholesterol, liver transaminases, serum creatinine, and urine cytochemical study).
In a general analysis performed by his family doctor, microhematuria and proteinuria were detected.

sentence_en: Given the clinical situation, it was decided to perform bilateral bronchoalveolar lavage.

The patient performed tidal volumes of 800 ml (volume/minute of 10 bpm) and his oxygenation was 96%.

Subsequently, we measured the static compliance of each lung (25 ml/cm H2O in the right lung and 15 ml/cm H2O in the left lung), so we decided to start the lavage in the left lung (the one that had the worst static compliance). with the patient in the supine position.
Lavage was performed with isotonic saline solution heated to 37º C. We infused one liter from a height of 30-40 cm above the patient and drained it by gravity.
The same operation was carried out until the washing liquid became clear.
13 liters were needed in this first phase.
To achieve a better result and drainage, thoracic percussion was performed on the washed lung.
After supine lavage, we observed an improvement in the static compliance of the left lung of up to 53 ml/cm H2O and an improvement in saturation of up to 98%.
We then place the patient in a prone position.
We perform the same procedure as supine, in this case 15 liters of saline solution at 37º C are necessary to obtain clear drainage.
The total time it took to lavage the left lung was 2 hours and 45 minutes.
After completing the lavage of the left lung, we ventilated both lungs in pressure control mode with 100% FiO2, PEEP 10 cm H2O and peak pressure of 35 cm H2O for 45 minutes.
The measured static compliance was 39 ml/cm H2O and the oxygen saturation was 96%.
We decided to ventilate the left lung alone, to check that it could tolerate lavage of the right lung.
The patient had good tolerance with an oxygen saturation of 96%.
We decided to begin lavage of the right lung starting in the prone position.
In this position the drainage began to clear with 20 liters of saline solution in one hour and 35 minutes.
We changed him to a supine position, with only 4 liters being necessary in this position in 14 minutes until clear drainage was obtained.
After 30 minutes of mechanical ventilation, the static compliance of both lungs was 64 ml/cm H2O and the oxygen saturation was 98%.
Finally, we changed the double lumen tube for a standard number 8 tube and began disconnecting the patient.
The patient was extubated two hours after completing lavage.
The follow-up chest x-ray showed a bilateral fine interstitial pattern.
When the patient was discharged from the intensive care unit he had a PaO2/FiO2 ratio of 453.8 (193.8 on admission).

sentence_en: The good evolution of the case during the first days after restarting CAPD encouraged us to make a new attempt to solve the problem through peritoneal rest, this time longer.

sentence_en: A 57-year-old woman, whose clinical history highlights a history of carotid body paraganglioma in the patient's sister, who was treated with surgical resection of the lesion.

sentence_en: She came to the service due to a 5-year history of increased cervical volume on the left side anterior to the sternocleidomastoid, slow growth, firm to palpation, mobile in an anteroposterior direction, with recent odynophagia and dysphonia.
Computed tomography with contrast medium shows a well-defined, hyperdense lobulated image measuring 29.7 × 33.3 mm, located in the carotid bifurcation, with no apparent airway involvement.
sentence_es: La tomografía computarizada con medio de contraste muestra una imagen lobulada hiperdensa, bien delimitada de 29,7 × 33,3 mm, localizada en la bifurcación carótida, sin aparente afectación de la vía aérea.

sentence_en: Angiography shows a typical "lyre" image, in which the ovoid lesion shows homogeneous contrast hyperenhancement, as well as an opening of the carotid bifurcation.
According to the clinical and imaging findings, the diagnosis of carotid body paraganglioma is made.

Due to the size of the lesion, selective embolization was performed with polidocanol foam and, 48 hours later, under general anesthesia and orotracheal intubation, surgical resection of the lesion was performed with a laterocervical approach anterior to the sternocleidomastoid muscle, dissection through planes until the lesion was located. , which is completely resected with subadventitial dissection; Collateral carotid branches are ligated for hemostatic purposes, maintaining the integrity of the carotid arteries.
sentence_es: Debido al tamaño de la lesión, se realiza embolización selectiva con espuma de polidocanol y, 48 horas después, bajo anestesia general e intubación orotraqueal, se realiza resección quirúrgica de la lesión con abordaje laterocervical anterior al músculo esternocleidomastoideo, disección por planos hasta ubicar la lesión, la cual se reseca completamente con disección subadventicia ; se ligan ramos carotídeos colaterales con fines hemostáticos manteniendo la integridad de las arterias carótidas.

sentence_en: The specimen obtained is sent for histopathological study, in which the presence of accumulations or nests of oval cells with uniform hyperchromatic nuclei surrounded by vascular stroma is observed, which make up the Zellballen pattern, the classic pattern of carotid body paraganglioma.

sentence_en: 6-year-old male patient, with no pathological history of interest, who comes to the dental office for a check-up.
In the intraoral examination he had exfoliation of the four upper incisors without any of the permanent ones erupting.
On palpation, a swelling was seen in the vestibular cortex that corresponded to the crowns of the upper central incisors, but these were located very far from the midline.
An orthopantomography was requested to assess the position and eruption status of the upper incisors.
The radiograph showed the presence of two mesiodens in the midline.
The one on the right side was in a more apical position and was larger than the left one.
Both were in a vertical position and had a conoid shape.
They caused a large interincisal diastema and prevented the correct eruption of the upper central incisors.
sentence_es: Provocaban un gran diastema interincisal e impedían la correcta erupción de los incisivos centrales superiores.

sentence_en: The mother was informed of the need to extract the supernumerary teeth for the correct dental eruption of the anterior sector, and the patient was referred to the maxillofacial surgery service for the surgical extraction of the mesiodens.

sentence_en: Before surgery, the patient had eruption of 1/3 of the crown of the left upper incisor and the cusp of the left mesiodens.

The maxillofacial surgery service decides to perform the intervention in two phases: first, it performs the surgical extraction of the left mesiodens and will perform the extraction of the right mesiodens when it is in a lower position.

The patient will require periodic check-ups to control tooth eruption and assess the need for subsequent orthodontic treatment to close the interincisal diastema and also allow the eruption of the upper lateral incisors.
sentence_es: El paciente precisará controles periódicos para controlar la erupción dentaria y valorar la necesidad de un tratamiento ortodóncico posterior para cerrar el diastema interincisal y permitir, además, la erupción de los incisivos laterales superiores.

0.1 cm thick.

sentence_en: The histological study showed that the lesion was made up of well-defined tumor nests without evidence of invasion of the renal parenchyma, encompassing a central mucinous matrix which constituted more than 50% of the tumor volume.

sentence_en: Within this matrix, loose neoplastic cells and nests of smaller size than those located at the peripheral level were found floating.

The tumor cells showed intense immunopositivity for EMA, CK 7 and mild for CK20; This, together with the morphology, confirmed the urothelial nature of the neoplasia.
With all the data presented, the diagnosis of low-grade transitional cell carcinoma, with intense mucinous differentiation, of the renal pelvis (colloid carcinoma) was made.

To do this, we adjust the diet to 20-25 g of high biological value proteins/day (PAVB: milk, eggs, meat, fish, cheese, cereals and legumes) distributed over breakfast, lunch and dinner (5-10 and 10 g). , with freedom in vegetables, greens, natural fruits, peeled potatoes, olives, sugar, oils, butter, corn starch (Maizena®), spices and low protein foods Loprofín®, Aglutella® and Aproten® purchased through the Association of PKU patients of Madrid.

sentence_en: The anatomo-pathological study of the submitted material showed the presence of amyloid material that was distributed around the submucosal vessels, as we can see in the hematoxylin-eosin staining.
